question: Which of the following Union Territories does NOT have a lieutenant governor?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Daman and Diu.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Daman and Diu is a Union Territory that was merged with Dadra and Nagar Haveli to form a new Union Territory called Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu, with a common administrator.**
 
• New Delhi, also known as the National Capital Territory of Delhi, has a lieutenant governor.
 
• Andaman and Nicobar Islands have a lieutenant governor.
 
• Puducherry, also known as Pondicherry, has a lieutenant governor.
 
• The lieutenant governor is the constitutional head of a Union Territory in India and is appointed by the President of India.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• New Delhi is the capital city of India and is a Union Territory with a population of over 18 million people.
 
• Daman and Diu is a small Union Territory located on the west coast of India and has a population of around 250,000 people.
 
• Andaman and Nicobar Islands is a group of islands located in the Bay of Bengal and has a population of around 380,000 people.
 
• Puducherry is a Union Territory located on the east coast of India and has a population of around 1.2 million people. It was a French colony until 1954 and has a unique blend of French and Indian cultures.
